lines.zh: 我在浑水里游，看不清也照样走。
lines.en: I swim through muddy water and travel blind.

lines.zh: 河底暗，我靠声音辨方向。
lines.en: The river bed is dark. I steer by sound.
I glide past the water weeds.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在泥上划出浅浅的印。
lines.en: My fin scores a shallow line in the silt.

lines.zh: 这条河我熟，弯在哪儿都知道。
lines.en: I know this river, every bend of it.

lines.zh: 我浮上来换气，又沉下去。
lines.en: I surface for air, then sink again.
The water is so thick I cannot see the sun.
I move along the riverbank slowly.

lines.zh: 有几条鱼从我的喙边躲开。
lines.en: A few fish dodge away from my snout.
One sweep of my tail and the silt blooms.
I slip under a tangle of roots.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤是粉的，在水里发灰。
lines.en: My pink skin goes grey underwater.
I hang in the water, fins barely moving.
Light from the surface shakes on my back.
I hear an axe ashore.

lines.zh: 我的喙很长，像一根棍子。
lines.en: My snout is long, like a stick.

lines.zh: 那顶帽子挂在岸边，我见过它主人。
lines.en: I've seen the owner of that hat on the bank.

lines.zh: 河底有东西在动，我盯着。
lines.en: Something moves on the bed. I watch.

lines.zh: 粉色的河豚，谁不想摸一下。
lines.en: A pink river dolphin. Who wouldn't reach out?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两侧，各看一边。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides, each watching its own way.

lines.zh: 这条河的鱼越来越少了。
lines.en: There are fewer fish in this river now.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥面滑了一小段。
lines.en: I slide a short way along the silt.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的尾，我甩开。
lines.en: Weeds snag my tail and I shake free.
I hear someone step into the river.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子顶出水面，吸一口气。
lines.en: I push my snout above the surface for a breath.
A layer of leaves floats on the river.

lines.zh: 我认得你站在岸上的样子。
lines.en: I know the look of you standing ashore.

lines.zh: 你脚边的水一直是浑的。
lines.en: The water by your feet stays murky.

lines.zh: 你是来打渔的，还是来找我。
lines.en: Are you fishing, or looking for me?
I rise with only my back showing.
What is in the water, you cannot catch.
If you are coming in, think first.
I have been following under your boat.

lines.zh: 粉色的河豚，会拉人下水。
lines.en: A pink river dolphin can pull you under.

lines.zh: 我在这条河里游得比你走得快。
lines.en: I swim this river faster than you walk.

lines.zh: 我背上的粉皮，在浑水里发亮。
lines.en: My pink hide glows in the murky water.
I am in no hurry. Water allows waiting.
Back off and I will stop following.
My nostrils break the surface before my head.

lines.zh: 你要看清楚，这河里不止我一个。
lines.en: Look closely. I am not the only one here.

lines.zh: 那顶帽子，是从别人头上来的。
lines.en: That hat came off someone else's head.

lines.zh: 我不会上岸，岸上不归我。
lines.en: I do not come ashore. The land is not mine.

lines.zh: 你低头找我的时候，我已经在船底。
lines.en: By the time you look down, I'm under your boat.

lines.zh: 数一数你还剩多少干的路。
lines.en: Count how much dry road you have left.
That scraped my skin open.

lines.zh: 血在水里化成粉色的一团。
lines.en: Blood blooms pink in the water.

lines.zh: 水里没有血的味道才奇怪。
lines.en: It would be strange if the water had no blood in it.
I retreat two body lengths into the deep.
That hit landed on my back.
I lash my tail and the surface breaks open.

lines.zh: 我还游得动，这就不算重。
lines.en: I can still swim. That makes it light.
It hurts. Water does not soften it.

lines.zh: 我记住了这一竿的力气。
lines.en: I have measured the force of that pole.
I dive to avoid the next one.
Fish. Throw it down and let me look.
I will not eat that fruit.
That fish is still moving. I take it.
I swallow it without asking where it came from.
Something is knocking in your net.

lines.zh: 我浮上来闻了闻，又沉下去。
lines.en: I surface, sniff, and sink again.

lines.zh: 河底的吃食，比你手上的多。
lines.en: There is more to eat on the river bed.
I am not picky. Fish is fish.
Leave the bucket on the bank.

lines.zh: 这味道让我靠近了你的船。
lines.en: That smell drew me to your boat.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的背，滑了一下。
lines.en: You hit my back and slipped.
Bumping under water does not hurt. Do not test it.
A river dolphin's skin is slick as water.

lines.zh: 我的背擦过你的小腿，很滑。
lines.en: My back slides past your calf, slick as water.
I swim half a circle around you.

lines.zh: 别踩河底，那里有我的窝。
lines.en: Do not wade the bed. My hollow is there.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的鳍擦到你了。
lines.en: My fin brushed you that time.
Move. I need air.
Your hull knocked against me.
I draw back half a body length. That is all.
I know that dance at the river bed.

lines.zh: 水浑的时候，谁也看不清谁。
lines.en: When the water is murky, nobody sees anyone.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle her, again and again.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用身体碰一下。
lines.en: We do not speak. We only touch once.
Her skin is pinker than mine.
We swim down the same river.

lines.zh: 这里的河窄，容得下两条。
lines.en: This river is narrow and fits two.

lines.zh: 之后它游进深水，我没跟。
lines.en: Afterward she went into deep water. I did not follow.
Even this body can miss something.
In the water there is no such thing as goodbye.

lines.zh: 河底有枚沉下去的硬币。
lines.en: A coin lies sunk in the bed.
I take up a scrap of cloth and spit it out.
This hat rolled into the water.

lines.zh: 我顶开一块石头，下面有东西。
lines.en: I nose a stone aside and something lies under it.
This orb is bright even underwater.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，带走了。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and carry it off.
There is iron in the wreck. I leave it.
Fish bones poke up out of the silt.
What sinks belongs to the river bed.
I nudge it all the way to the bank.
Someone has entered the water.

lines.zh: 他的脚在水里，我看得清。
lines.en: His feet are in the water and I see them.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子只有他一个。
lines.en: There is only one shadow on the surface.
I move toward his feet.

lines.zh: 这条河的弯角，正好藏身。
lines.en: The bend of this river hides me well.

lines.zh: 我把背露出水面，慢慢靠。
lines.en: I show my back and close in slowly.
He is still in the shallows.
That pole in his hands is not long.
He shifted half a step.

lines.zh: 这个位置，我能从下面过。
lines.en: From here I can pass underneath.
He is walking toward the middle.

lines.zh: 我听见水被踩开的声音。
lines.en: I hear the water being trodden apart.

lines.zh: 我在他身后两身远的地方。
lines.en: I am two body lengths behind him.

lines.zh: 目标清楚，就是那个影子。
lines.en: Target clear: that shadow.
I sink, then rise again.
He is about to look up.
I circled once around his legs.

lines.zh: 他总是踩着水里的树枝。
lines.en: He keeps stepping on sunken branches.
I hold the water so it makes no sound.

lines.zh: 他的脚在水里越来越慢。
lines.en: His feet slow in the water.
I stay downstream of him.

lines.zh: 他回头看岸，什么也没有。
lines.en: He looks back at the bank. Nothing.
That brush was not the wind.

lines.zh: 我在等他站到深一点的地方。
lines.en: I wait for him to stand in deeper water.
Water reaches my back and his waist.
He has begun backing toward the bank.
I swim faster than he retreats.
His pole has fallen in.
He reaches for it. There it is.
I wait beneath his hand.
That circle brought me close enough.
One more tail stroke and I am on him.
He has backed into water with no way out.
His breath breaks the surface unevenly.
I butt the back of his knee.

lines.zh: 我咬住他的小腿往下拖。
lines.en: I bite his calf and drag him down.
My long snout strikes his chest.

lines.zh: 我把他从浅水里挤出去。
lines.en: I shove him out of the shallows.
My tail sweeps across his waist.
I roll and take him over with me.
He grabs my back and cannot hold.
I press him under.
The blow pushes him to midstream.
He choked on a mouthful of water.
I strike his feet from below.

lines.zh: 他伸手乱抓，什么也没抓到。
lines.en: He grabs about and finds nothing.

lines.zh: 我绕到他背后，再撞一次。
lines.en: I circle behind him and hit again.

lines.zh: 他往岸上爬，我咬住他的衣角。
lines.en: He climbs for the bank; I catch his hem.

lines.zh: 他扒住岸边的草，我松了口。
lines.en: He clutches the bank grass and I let go.
I heave with my back and he loses his footing.
My back rises out of the murky water.
River water runs off me.
I have swum this river many years.
Roots reach down into the water.
I lift my head for the first breath.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在浅水里发粉。
lines.en: My skin shows pink in the shallows.

lines.zh: 长喙破开水面，我先吸一口气。
lines.en: My long snout breaks the surface, and I take a breath.
I keep this stretch of water.
It is much quieter below.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，看了一会儿岸。
lines.en: I surface and watch the bank awhile.
My arrival stirs the silt.

lines.zh: 天亮的时候，水里最安全。
lines.en: At daybreak the water is safest.
I come swimming from the deep water.
My back cuts through a patch of duckweed.
I must go around the roots below.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，四面都看。
lines.en: I lift my head out and scan every side.

lines.zh: 这条河的水位比昨天高。
lines.en: The river runs higher than yesterday.

lines.zh: 岸边的泥上有新的脚印。
lines.en: There are fresh prints in the bank mud.
Fire spread on the surface and I dropped away.

lines.zh: 河水被抽走，我摔在泥上。
lines.en: The river drained and I fell onto mud.

lines.zh: 网把我按在水底，我挣不开。
lines.en: A net holds me on the bed and I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 爆响在水里闷了一下，我翻白。
lines.en: The blast thumped through the water and I rolled over.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了水面，扎进我背。
lines.en: An arrow punched the surface and lodged in my back.
Strange light burns me underwater.

lines.zh: 这条河里已经没有鱼了。
lines.en: There are no fish left in this river.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我全身一紧。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water and my whole body clenched.

lines.zh: 河底的泥开了个口，我掉下去。
lines.en: A hole opened in the bed and I fell through.
